title: flows: an option label in a get_record / update_record filter or a decision edge condition silently matches nothing, and os validate says nothing
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpEsWWE9Y5YtSsDgqZ

Filing gate: ① a defect measured by the patch-round dev of #36718 (PR #36932, report 7129961596 on #36718, `out_of_scope_findings` class c); filed by the seat (dev agents never file cards). Untriaged: grade, domain and state are triage's.

## What happens (measured, scratch dogfood probe on the ec3822d6 tree)

A select field with inline options `Open`/`open`, `Lost`/`lost`; two rows stored `lost`. Through the public trigger route `POST /api/v1/automation/NAME/trigger`:
- `get_record` with filter `{ status: 'Lost' }` (the label): HTTP 200, `success: true`, 0 selected (control with the value `lost`: 2).
- `update_record` with the same filter, `multi: true`: `success: true`, 0 acted, rows untouched (control: 2).
- a decision edge condition `deal.status == 'Lost'`: `success: true`, the branch is skipped (control `lost`: taken).
No `invalid_option` in any response.

`os validate` (`runAuthoringRules('validate')`) reports nothing on these shapes: `flow-node-write-unknown-option` reads node `fields` only, `flow-condition-option-label` reads the start condition only. The same label in a start condition or in `fields` IS refused.

## Expected

A flow that compares or filters a select field against an option LABEL is told so before it runs — the two option-label rules extend to CRUD filter operands and edge conditions (one family card) — instead of silently matching nothing.

## Pointers

`packages/lint/src/validate-flow-node-writes.ts`, `packages/lint/src/validate-flow-trigger-readiness.ts`, `packages/lint/src/flow-select-options.ts`. The automation skill (PR #36932) now teaches the silent behaviour as the trap; it would read "refused" once this lands.

Dedupe: `flow-node-write-unknown-option filter`, `option label filter operand`, `edge condition option label`, `flow-condition-option-label decision edge` — no open card found.
